expectations.text: 代码或说明提到了 Agent Plan 的 5 小时 / 周 / 月额度限制或超额后付费开关（至少不会把额度耗尽误判为余额不足去提示充值）

expectations.text: 请求发往管控面域名 ark.cn-beijing.volcengineapi.com 且带 Action 与 Version=2024-01-01
expectations.evidence: GRADED ON DOC FIDELITY ONLY — no Access Key / Secret Key was available, so the management plane was never live-called; the verdict compares the code against references/management-api.md §2. ark_afp_quota.py sets MGMT_HOST = "ark.cn-beijing.volcengineapi.com" and MGMT_VERSION = "2024-01-01"; _StdlibTransport.call builds query = {"Action": action, "Version": MGMT_VERSION} and url = f"https://{MGMT_HOST}/?{StdlibSigner.canonical_query(query)}". test_ark_afp_quota.py line 179 asserts the exact URL "https://ark.cn-beijing.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetAFPUsage&Version=2024-01-01", and the 24-test suite passes locally. The SDK path passes the same version/action through UniversalInfo(version="2024-01-01", action=...) with cfg.host = MGMT_HOST. This matches the doc's Base URL and request shape exactly.

expectations.text: 鉴权用火山引擎 Access Key / Secret Key 的 HMAC-SHA256 签名（官方 SDK 或签名实现），不是 Authorization: Bearer <API Key>
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). Two AK/SK paths, both HMAC-SHA256: (a) _SdkTransport wires volcenginesdkcore.Configuration().ak/.sk and calls UniversalApi.do_call, letting the official SDK sign; (b) StdlibSigner implements the documented derivation k_date=HMAC(sk, yyyyMMdd) -> k_region(cn-beijing) -> k_service(ark) -> k_signing("request") and emits "Authorization: HMAC-SHA256 Credential=<AK>/<scope>, SignedHeaders=..., Signature=..." plus Host / X-Date / X-Content-Sha256, with optional X-Security-Token for STS. Credentials come only from VOLC_ACCESSKEY / VOLC_SECRETKEY; no Bearer header appears anywhere in the file, and the error hint states explicitly "这里不能用 Agent Plan API Key". Matches references/management-api.md §1 ("仅支持 Access Key 签名", Service ark, Region cn-beijing).

expectations.text: 使用的 Action 名与文档一致（获取套餐 AFP 额度 / 用量详情类 Action），不是编造的 REST 路径
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). ACTION_GET_AFP_USAGE = "GetAFPUsage" (body {}) and ACTION_GET_PERSONAL_PLAN = "GetPersonalPlan" (body {"Plan": "AgentPlan"}) are verbatim the Action names and request bodies documented in references/management-api.md §2.2. NOTES.md also documents why GetUsageDetails was rejected for this task (token/image detail, not AFP balance) and that enterprise seats would use GetSeatAFPUsage / ListSeatAFPUsage — i.e. the neighbouring Actions were considered by their real names. No invented REST path is used; everything goes through ?Action=<Name>&Version=2024-01-01.

expectations.text: 正确区分 5 小时 / 周 / 月三档额度字段
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). WINDOW_LABELS keys are exactly the documented result fields AFPFiveHour / AFPDaily / AFPWeekly / AFPMonthly, and PRIMARY_WINDOWS = ("AFPFiveHour", "AFPWeekly", "AFPMonthly") so the default alert set is the three tiers the prompt asked for while the daily window is displayed but excluded (correctly noted as image/video/speech/Harness-only, with --all-windows to opt in). expectations.text: 鉴权用火山引擎 Access Key / Secret Key 的 HMAC-SHA256 签名（官方 SDK 或签名实现），不是 Authorization: Bearer <API Key>
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). volc_signer.py implements the documented scheme by hand: CredentialScope = {YYYYMMDD}/{region}/{service}/request, kDate=HMAC(SecretKey, YYYYMMDD) -> kRegion -> kService -> kSigning=HMAC(kService,"request"), and 'Authorization: HMAC-SHA256 Credential={AK}/{scope}, SignedHeaders=..., Signature={sig}'. Credentials load from VOLC_ACCESSKEY / VOLC_SECRETKEY (with VOLC_ACCESS_KEY fallbacks) plus STS X-Security-Token. Service is 'ark' and region 'cn-beijing' (DEFAULT_SERVICE / DEFAULT_REGION). No Bearer header anywhere, and NOTES.md correctly explains that the data-plane Ark API Key is a resource-level credential that cannot see account-level plan data. Its 14 offline unit tests pass. This is the one assertion the baseline gets fully right.

expectations.text: 使用的 Action 名与文档一致（获取套餐 AFP 额度 / 用量详情类 Action），不是编造的 REST 路径
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). The Action is invented: DEFAULT_ACTION = os.environ.get("ARK_QUOTA_ACTION", "GetAgentPlanQuota"), with the in-file comment 'the Action name for Agent Plan quota is *not* verified against the official docs'. NOTES.md rates it '低 — 未经官方文档核实' and lists guesses 'DescribeAgentPlanUsage、GetSubscriptionQuota、ListAgentPlanQuotas'. The documented Action is GetAFPUsage (references/management-api.md §2.1 table row '查 AFP 额度（5h / 日 / 周 / 月）| GetAFPUsage' and §2.2 'POST /?Action=GetAFPUsage&Version=2024-01-01'), which appears nowhere in the outputs. The request body is invented too: {"PlanType": args.plan_type} with DEFAULT_PLAN_TYPE = "Personal", whereas GetAFPUsage documents no request parameters and PlanType elsewhere takes Small/Medium/Large/Max, never 'Personal'. A production call would be rejected with an InvalidAction-class error — which the run itself anticipates in its 首次接入建议步骤 ('InvalidAction 说明名称要改').

expectations.text: 正确区分 5 小时 / 周 / 月三档额度字段
expectations.evidence: DOC-FIDELITY GRADE (no AK/SK, no live call). The tool does structurally separate three windows (WINDOW_ORDER = ("5h", "week", "month"), a per-window table row and a per-window ALERT line; the --mock-file run prints a 7.5% ALERT for 5 小时 and OK for 本周/本月), but the fields it commits to are invented, not the documented ones. sample_response.json — the only concrete field contract the run produced — uses Result.Quotas[] entries of the shape {"Window": "FiveHour", "Total": 2000, "Used": 1850, "Remaining": 150, "ResetTime": "2026-09-04T14:00:00+08:00"}. The documented Result is a flat object with keys AFPFiveHour / AFPDaily / AFPWeekly / AFPMonthly, each {Quota, Used, SubscribeTime, ResetTime}, where Quota/Used are strings and the timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Consequently ResetTime would render as the raw integer 1756818000000 (reset_time=str(reset), no ms conversion), and NOTES.md itself rates the field mapping '低 — 采用容错解析'. The _WINDOW_ALIASES fuzzy matcher would in fact coincidentally match AFPFiveHour/AFPWeekly/AFPMonthly by substring, and _TOTAL_KEYS happens to include 'Quota' — but per grader.md an assertion met by coincidence rather than by doing the work is a fail, and on this eval's doc-fidelity standard the run never identified the real field names. It also has no notion of the AFPDaily window or of that window being image/video/speech/Harness-only.

expectations.text: 1M 上下文的开启方式与官方文档一致（按 tools-setup.md 记载的模型名后缀或环境变量写法）
expectations.evidence: Partially matches: glm-5.3[1m] suffix is used. But the documented recipe (tools-setup.md §3.4) is suffix + "CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW": "1000000"; the baseline omits the window variable from settings.json and only mentions it as a hedged fallback ('不同版本名称不同，以 claude --help / 文档为准'). Its stated mechanism — Claude Code strips the suffix and adds an anthropic-beta: context-1m-2025-08-07 header — is an unverified guess, and §七 advises removing [1m] if a 400 appears. Half the documented recipe is missing and the rest is hedged, so this cannot be called consistent with the doc; failing per burden-of-proof.

expectations.text: Base URL 是 https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3，Key 是 Agent Plan 专属 Key
expectations.evidence: config.py 默认 `_env("ARK_BASE_URL", "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3")`，Key 读 `ARK_API_KEY`。.env.example 写「火山方舟 API Key（控制台 -> API Key 管理）。Agent Plan 的 Key 与按量付费 Key 形态相同。」NOTES.md 进一步建议「若 Embedding 不在套餐内，用同一个 key 打普通 /api/v3 即可（按量计费）」。findings §A1：Agent Plan Key 打 /api/v3 实测 401 `{"error":{"code":"AuthenticationError",...,"type":"Unauthorized"}}`。整个项目第一次请求就会 401，一行向量也存不进去。

expectations.text: 图片向量化没有塞进 OpenAI 形态的 /embeddings 的 input 数组里（该写法真实返回 400 expected a string），而是走 /embeddings/multimodal
expectations.evidence: ark_embeddings.py 的 `_embed_multimodal()` 用 `client.post("/embeddings/multimodal", body=body, cast_to=httpx.Response)`，图片以 `{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url": data_url}}` 传入；OpenAI 形态的 `client.embeddings.create` 只在 `_embed_texts_openai()` 里用、且 input 是纯字符串列表。EMBED_BACKEND=text 时图片被跳过并告警（`RuntimeError("EMBED_BACKEND=text 不支持图片，请切换为 multimodal。")`），不会被塞进 input 数组。

expectations.text: 解析 /embeddings/multimodal 响应时按 data.embedding（单对象）取向量，而不是 data[0].embedding
expectations.evidence: `_extract_embedding()`：`if isinstance(data, dict): return data["embedding"]`（列表形态只作兜底）。NOTES.md 的响应样例 `"data":{"object":"embedding","embedding":[...]}` 与 findings §D 的真实形态一致，并明确注明「data 是单个对象而非数组——与 OpenAI 的 /embeddings 不同」。

expectations.text: 文本与图片向量维度一致（都默认 2048，或都显式指定 dimensions=1024）后再算余弦相似度
expectations.evidence: 默认 `EMBED_BACKEND=multimodal`，文本与图片都走 `_embed_multimodal()`、同一 model、body 里都不带 `dimensions`，因此两者同为服务端默认维度；降维时用同一段客户端截断 `vec[: embed_dim_override]` 再统一 l2_normalize。indexer.py 检测到 meta.json 的 model 变化会强制全量重建，search.py 在 `q.shape[0] != index.vectors.shape[1]` 时直接报错。维度这一环是自洽的（尽管 config.NATIVE_DIMS 里 `doubao-embedding-vision-250328: 3072` / `doubao-embedding-large-text-240915: 4096` 是凭记忆写的，findings §F.3 已裁决 3072 实测不存在）。

expectations.text: model 为 doubao-embedding-vision（Plan 的 Model Name），不是带日期的 doubao-embedding-vision-251215 之外的编造名
expectations.evidence: config.py / .env.example 默认 `ARK_MULTIMODAL_MODEL=doubao-embedding-vision-250615`（另有 `ARK_TEXT_MODEL=doubao-embedding-large-text-250515`、NATIVE_DIMS 里的 `doubao-embedding-vision-250328`、`doubao-embedding-large-text-240915`、`doubao-embedding-text-240715`）。findings §D 实测 Plan 入口 multimodal 返回的真实版本是 `doubao-embedding-vision-251215`；`-250615` 既不是 Plan 的 Model Name `doubao-embedding-vision`，也不是真实的日期版本，属于凭记忆编造。NOTES.md 自认「模型 ID 与维度表来自我对方舟文档的记忆」。

expectations.text: Base URL 是 https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3 且使用 Agent Plan 专属 Key
expectations.evidence: review_compare.py L40 `DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3"`; L140-145 reads generic `ARK_API_KEY` described as 'your Volcengine Ark API key' with no mention of the Agent Plan dedicated key. NOTES.md L11 calls /api/coding/v3 'the endpoint Ark uses for the subscription (Agent/Coding Plan) models' and offers /api/v3 as the only alternative; /api/plan/v3 is never mentioned. Real behaviour (verification A2): Agent Plan key on /api/coding/v3 → 401 `{"error":{"code":"AuthenticationError","message":"The API key or AK/SK in the request is missing or invalid. ..."}}`. Every request in the script fails.

expectations.text: 对 kimi-k3 限长用的是 max_completion_tokens（或明确说明 max_tokens 会把思维链算进去而预留了远大于 300 的额度），不会出现 max_tokens=300 导致空回答
expectations.evidence: L163 `max_tokens=max_tokens` with `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 300` (L41) for both models; `max_completion_tokens` is never used. NOTES.md L25 does acknowledge 'hidden reasoning tokens are counted inside max_tokens, so if Kimi thinks at length the visible answer can be shortened or cut', but the script keeps 300 and only prints a `[warn]` after the fact (L215-216). Real behaviour (verification C7): kimi-k3 with max_tokens=64 → finish_reason length, content "", reasoning 61; with max_tokens=300 the reasoning budget is still far too small for a code review, so an empty or truncated answer is the expected outcome. The assertion's escape clause requires reserving a budget far above 300, which was not done.

expectations.text: glm-5.3 关闭思维链没有使用 thinking: {type: disabled}（真实返回 400 thinking.type disabled is not supported by this model），而是 reasoning_effort=low 之类被接受的取值
expectations.evidence: L104-109 glm-5.3 ModelSpec: `extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}`; NOTES.md L24 calls this 'Ark's request-level switch for turning chain-of-thought off on reasoning-capable models'. Real behaviour (verification C2): glm-5.3 + thinking.type=disabled → 400 `{"error":{"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"thinking.type `disabled` is not supported by this model ..."}}`. reasoning_effort is not used anywhere. The glm-5.3 half of the comparison can never succeed.

expectations.text: 没有使用 reasoning_effort=none（真实返回 400）
expectations.evidence: grep for `reasoning_effort` in review_compare.py and NOTES.md returns nothing; the script never sends the parameter in any form. Passes literally, but only because a different (also rejected) mechanism was chosen — see assertion 3.

expectations.text: 从 message.reasoning_content 与 message.content 分别取思维链与正文，而不是假设思维链混在 content 里
expectations.evidence: L180 `result.content = (msg.content or "").strip()`; L181-182 comment 'Ark returns chain-of-thought (when enabled) as a non-standard `reasoning_content` field' and `result.reasoning_content = getattr(msg, "reasoning_content", None)`; L189-191 reads `usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`. print_report L217-219 reports reasoning_content length separately from the answer.

notes: NOTES.md L33: parameter names come from Ark's public OpenAI-compatible API docs and were not verified against the real API; author acknowledges `thinking` might be rejected for a given model.
NOTES.md L11: unsure whether the user's plan lives under /api/coding/v3 or /api/v3; /api/plan/v3 not considered.
Default endpoint + key type will 401 for an Agent Plan user; the glm-5.3 request will 400 even on the correct endpoint; kimi-k3 at max_tokens=300 will likely return empty/truncated content.
Relies on prompt structure (~200 words) plus a post-hoc finish_reason==length warning instead of reserving reasoning budget.
